media.title: AU Executive Council Appoints Dr Tidiane Ouattara as the President of the African Space Council
media.excerpt: During the 37th Ordinary Session of the AU Assembly, the Executive Council appointed Dr Tidiane Ouattara as the inaugural president of the African Space Council to lead the operationalisation of the African Space Agency (AfSA).

media.title: Dr Tidiane Ouattara Sworn in as President of the African Space Council
